shows.title: CLASS: Annoyance Summer Intensive Part 2: August 17 - 21
shows.excerpt: Annoyance 2026 Summer Intensives 5 day course - 6 hours per day PART 1: The Annoyance Training Center teaches students how to develop and maintain a strong individual voice in their improvisation. These intensives will address the initiatio
shows.description: Annoyance 2026 Summer Intensives 5 day course - 6 hours per day PART 1: The Annoyance Training Center teaches students how to develop and maintain a strong individual voice in their improvisation. These intensives will address the initiation of a scene; developing and maintaining strong characters; learning to hold on to your initial choices while at the same time, expanding on (heightening) the choices you have made; and learning to become deft at creating and weaving unexpected, character-based choices into your work. Annoyance classes challenge the conventional wisdom of the rules of improvisation, examining what’s behind them and how they came to be in the first place. Simply put, we make you the best improviser YOU can be. All of our intensive teachers are ensemble members who have learned and performed with The Annoyance, and thus have first hand experience with the way we approach improvisation. PART 2: Took the Intensive Part 1 and want more? Want to go further with your exploration of our philosophy? This is for you! With this intensive sequel, we go deeper into the teachings of The Annoyance, tackling things like context, group scene work, ensemble and much more. Prerequisite for Part 2: Students must have previously completed an Annoyance Part 1 Intensive or have completed AP5 within The Annoyance Training Center SCHEDULE: Classes: Mon - Fri 10am-5pm with a 1 hour break for lunch (1-2pm) Optional Workshops: Mon - Thu 5-7pm Optional Showcase: Fri 6pm Registration is Non-Refundable: Please be sure about your schedule before you register for class. Here’s why…. Your enrollment HOLDS A SPACE in a class that we are no longer able to offer someone else. Class payments are NON-REFUNDABLE, NON-TRANSFERABLE, and can be applied only to the current term’s class for which you have signed up. This applies if you get cast in a show, get a new job, or other situation, or have other changes to your schedule. So please be sure about your schedule before you register.

Looking for the best live improv comedy in Los Angeles? The Incubator at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre is a must-see monthly show featuring the next generation of performers alongside some of UCB’s most exciting veteran teams—all on one stage.

This unique double-bill improv show brings together two distinct voices in long-form improv: a rising Lloyd team and a graduated Harold team. This cycle, catch Dance Club Remix as they workshop an entirely new show over a 12-week run. It’s a rare opportunity to see top-tier improvisers experiment, refine, and build something brand new in real time.

The Incubator delivers an unforgettable night of live comedy, featuring both emerging talent and established UCB performers.

shows.title: Magic Mondays
shows.excerpt: Experience an unforgettable night of wonder at Magic Mondays!! Starring award-winning magician John Sturk, this monthly showcase features Chicago's top conjurors performing mind-blowing illusions and spellbinding tricks. Join us for an evening of ...
shows.description: Experience an unforgettable night of wonder at Magic Mondays!! Starring award-winning magician John Sturk, this monthly showcase features Chicago's top conjurors performing mind-blowing illusions and spellbinding tricks. Join us for an evening of magic, mystery, and mesmerizing entertainment—perfect for magic lovers and those looking for a night out with a twist! Don't miss your chance to witness the impossible. John Sturk is an award-winning comedy magician from Chicago. He has been seen on ABC, NBC, WGN, Fox, and The Travel Channel. He’s also graced the stages of The Second City, iO Chicago, The Annoyance Theater, Malarkey Theater, and countless living rooms and backyards throughout the midwest. In 2023, he served as National President of The Society of American Magicians, the oldest magic association in the world. In addition to magic, John is also one of Chicago’s most accomplished music directors, having been seen behind the keyboards of Chicago’s comedy institutions. He also is an official artist for Hammond Organs USA.

shows.description: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s the day for your first open mic (kudos) – The Ya'll Mic is a great venue to workshop your bits. The show is every Tuesday from 5:30pm – 7:30pm. Signup is online and the signup sheet is posted on Facebook & IG on Mondays. The list is emailed out a few hours before the show. Comics get 4 minutes of stage time (and a lifetime of memories.) While all are welcome, the room prioritizes BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and Femme comics. Come laugh with us!

shows.description:
All Out! is UCB’s newest LGBTQ+forward stand-up open mic for queer-identifying comics and allies!

All Out! is UCB’s brand new LGBTQ+ focussed monthly stand-up open mic here to cultivate a safe, supportive space for queer-identifying comics (and allies!) to take risks, build community and have fun!

Come through every 3rd Tuesday to see some of L.A.’s funniest comics-on-the-rise as they try out new material, fine-tune their tight five and let those pride flags fly.

Comic sign-ups are in person on the day of lottery style, so arrive 5-10 minutes early to throw your name in the bucket for a 5 minute set (10 slots total).

We encourage everyone to stay for the entire show to celebrate and support each other, so as an added incentive one name will be drawn (from all comics remaining by show’s end) to get a juicy 10 minute set in next month’s show!

Hosted by Koschka Bahr

shows.description:
You’re officially invited to Trifecta’s 10 year anniversary! Trifecta Comedy is turning 10 and we are putting on a sketch show to celebrate!

This 50 minute show will feature sketches by Trifecta Comedy full of big characters, musical numbers, and plenty of twists and turns. Come see Trifecta Comedy this August during their world tour…in LA. You can catch the 10 year show at Upright Citizens Brigade (UCB Franklin), The Broadwater Main Stage, and The Pack Theater!

Trifecta Comedy is a Los Angeles based sketch comedy group with 8 wild, animated, and creative artists. Trifecta is hot coming off of their recent back to back wins of Sketch Cagematch at UCB! They are an indie sketch comedy troupe that has been performing together since 2016. Their work has been showcased by Sketchfest Seattle, Austin Micro Film Festival, Burbank Comedy Festival, Mach Improv LA Festival, and Funny or Die. Trifecta Comedy regularly performs live sketch comedy shows in the Hollywood area and at Flappers Comedy Club in Burbank! The members of Trifecta Comedy have trained at UCB, Groundlings, Second City Hollywood, IO West, UCLA, and USC.

An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable.

The comedy laboratory where anything can happen!

Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its own theme, challenge, or format, so no two nights are the same.

One week, comedians might be doing crowd work. The next, they could be battling A.I in a joke battle, getting “analyzed” by therapists, or trying a brand-new experiment.

Whether it works perfectly or completely falls apart, that’s part of the fun.

shows.description:
Cancer isn’t funny but college kids are!

Back to College vs Cancer is a one-night comedy event that brings together college-aged and professional stand-up comedians to make a difference through laughter.

Join us for an unforgettable night featuring some of the funniest rising comedians. Every ticket purchased helps support groundbreaking cancer research for adolescents and young adults while connecting a new generation of performers and audiences around a cause that touches millions of families.

Cancer is the leading disease-related cause of death among adolescents and young adults, yet research on this age group remains dramatically underfunded. College vs Cancer channels student-led events—comedy shows, sports tournaments, and more—into raising awareness and funding research on why cancer rates are rising in young people and how to beat it.

Interested in getting involved? Follow us on instagram @college.vs.cancer

shows.description:
Improvised hip-hop homage to Hamilton. You shout the celebrity, we make up the musical!

Baby Wants Candy’s improvised hit Hamilton-inspired hip hop homage returns to UCBNY! New York Times “One of the Top 5 Comedy’s to Catch”.

Ever heard of this show “Hamilton”? Shamilton is just like that, but (ahem) better! Expect the same level of hip hop, incredible songs, stunning choreography and powerhouse singing… except made up on the spot!

Fresh off a month-long fully sold-out run at the Edinburgh Fringe and four months of fully sold-out shows at UCBLA, musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy presents “Shamilton!”, the Hamilton inspired hit hip-hop musical created in 2016 at UCB, with an open run at Chicago’s Second City.

Join the Shamilton cast as they improvise an epic musical based on a historical figure of your choosing- from Genghis Khan to Mr. Rogers to Kim Kardashian… to basketball playing superdog Air Bud.

It’s the show
The Guardian calls “Brilliant 4 stars”
The New York Times calls “One of the top 5 comedy shows to catch”.
and Lin-Manuel Miranda calls, “cease and desist!”

shows.description: If you’re looking for a date night, girls’ night out, or a mandatory work outing (that your staff will actually like) — Look no further! Fast, funny, and frothy, Thursday Night Improv is entirely improvised and features a different guest opener for veteran iO house team Creamboy every week. Every show is completely different, so you can keep coming back for more! Will you be the lucky audience member to receive the coveted title of Cream of the Week? Creamboy is made up of seasoned Chicago improvisers who play and teach all over the city (and country! And WORLD?!) which means this show is perfect for improv nerds, millennials who love Tina Fey, and even your cousin visiting from Kansas. Comedy so good you'll lick your lips and pat your belly. Mmmm so creamy! Get a taste of Creamboy on Instagram @ creamboy.io

shows.title: Improv: The Play
shows.excerpt: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never ...
shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. Featuring: Alex Beard Heather Mari Elijah Sloan Lexi Putter Lucas Pollitzer Marino Korellis Montrez Hawkins Nikk Tetreault Ryan Bowman Shawna Seals Directed by: James Dugan Produced by: Cory Hardin

shows.description: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. Doors Open 9:00 PM Show 9:30 PM - 10:45 PM Cost $6.49 ($5 Ticket + $1.49 Fees)

shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

shows.description:
Two of NYC’s top indie teams split one hour of longform improv comedy with special guests!

The disciples of clint and the bastards of SLOP will merge into one being as they do something no one has ever attempted: split one hour of longform improv comedy. Featuring surprise guests!

About the teams:

Clint – Improv is our prayer, and clint is our god. Your suggestions are wishes granted by god (clint). The disciples of clint (Andy Vega, Carly Lant, Dom Finseth, and Emma Campbell) have evangelized at the Steelstacks Improv Festival, conquered the false clint at Fun & Dumb, and embarrassed heretics at UCB’s Cagematch.

SLOP – A Brooklyn based comedy creature made out of Grant Cleaveland, Levi Collins, and Joe Harrington. Known for their highly physical, weird ass style, SLOP won 10 rounds of UCB’s Cagematch in 2024. SLOP has performed at iO Fest, Fun & Dumb Improv Festival, and was a Home Team at Brooklyn Comedy Collective in 2024.

shows.description: "...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader Improvised Jane Austen continues its entirely improvised tales of love and laughter this summer. Audiences will enjoy an evening with wit and heart in equal measure with an improvised rom-com for everyone, whether you love Austen or just like to laugh! Improvised Jane Austen currently performs Saturday nights at 6:00 pm at iO Theater and tickets are $20. "...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago Join Improvised Jane Austen for the signature romantic comedy and social satire of the beloved author, improvised by Chicago's top comedic talent. Celebrate all things love, friendship, and Austen this Summer. “...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to create a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. The current cast of 20+ performers rotate weekly, creating a new ensemble for every show. Come for the humor, stay for the heart! Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended , named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick , voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago , and was featured on WTTW playlist , in Time Out , the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day , on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago . Learn more: https://improvisedjaneausten.com/

shows.title: The Armando Diaz Experience
shows.description: The legendary show is reborn! Created in 1995 at the iO Theater in Chicago, The Armando Diaz Experience IS the longest running improv show EVER. A guest monologist takes a suggestion from the audience and shares true stories from their life. These stories are then brought to life by a rotating cast of improv all-stars, which take audiences on a high minded, exhilarating comedic joy ride that will leave mouths tired of smiling. And occasionally, just occasionally, the man with his name on the show will drop by for some fun. "The “Armando,” performed every Saturday, always begins with a monologue, and at a recent show it was about a connection made on the internet that led a decade later to a real-life relationship. The team of improvisers built patient scenes off this moving story, which made daring shifts in perspective, from the real world to secret worlds, inside and outside of bodies. There was a playfulness to the creativity, bold choices that verged on reckless that wouldn’t make the transition to a script." shows.description:
A brutally honest comedy about keeping tiny humans alive when you are dying inside.

Created and performed by playwright, comedian, and viral creator Brandon Ogborn, SAHD (Stay-At-Home Dad) is a brutally honest one-man show about what happens when someone who grew up homeschooled in a religious cult tries to become a normal stay-at-home dad. From navigating the daily chaos of raising small children to processing his father’s thirteen-year obsession with creating a Rush Limbaugh board game, carbon monoxide poisoning, and cosmic fire truck visits, Ogborn weaves together stories that are equal parts ridiculous and truly heartbreaking. Through deeply personal storytelling, he discovers that the people who drive us crazy are often the same ones who somehow keep us sane.

Created and performed by Brandon Ogborn

Directed by Karole Foreman

ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

What Is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians taking the stage with a surprise celebrity guest. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our “monologist “ shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestions. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world.

Previous celebrity guests include: Will Ferrell, Mark Hamill, Tina Fey, Charles Barkley, Don Cheadle, Elizabeth Banks, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani, Amy Poehler, Robin Williams and more.

shows.excerpt: See a brand new sketch or solo show birthed right before your eyes that is auditioning for a run at the UCB theater. It's a show where we let sketch teams and solo performers try some shit out! Some will…
shows.description:
See a brand new sketch or solo show birthed right before your eyes that is auditioning for a run at the UCB theater.

It’s a show where we let sketch teams and solo performers try some shit out!

Some will be good, some will be bad but it will all be weird and new and that’s what makes it fun!

It’s experimental sketch at its finest! Come on, you know you need a spanking.

This Monday, we have…

Trust Me, I’m from Essex: You can take the girl out of Essex, but can you take Essex out of the girl? A new, hard-hitting yet hopeful solo musical about following your dreams – no matter how unlikely they may seem.

When Lindsay Lucas-Bartlett was growing up in Southend-on-Sea, sharing a home with her abusive bipolar father and drug addict brother, her dreams of escaping the stereotypical Essex girl’s fate consisted of (a) marrying Prince William, and (b) running away to the magical city of Los Angeles. But Prince William started losing his hair and besides, what’s the point of swapping one dysfunctional family for another? Which leaves the other option…

In this autobiographical solo musical, directed by Lindsay Perry, with witty, hummable live songs composed by E. Aaron Wilson, lyrics by Lucas-Bartlett; Trust Me, I’m from Essex confronts brutal social issues, such as bipolar disorder, domestic abuse, drug addiction, bullying, undiagnosed dyslexia and date rape, head-on, but in an unflinching, yet wryly humorous, style that will have audiences cheering Lindsay on, as she fights to find a better life and negotiate the curveballs that fate throws her way – innit?

Written & performed by Lindsay Lucas-Bartlett

Directed by Lindsay Perry

Music by Aaron Wilson

shows.excerpt: We burnt it all down. Come hear how we plan to blow it back up. If you've ever wanted to hear the words, "so the Swifties were battling the Nazis," come to this show. As Kanye West said, "it's good…
shows.description:
We burnt it all down. Come hear how we plan to blow it back up.

If you’ve ever wanted to hear the words, “so the Swifties were battling the Nazis,” come to this show. As Kanye West said, “it’s good deal.”

When Kanye shared Mike Glazer‘s joke in 2025, Glazer thought his life was about to change. And it did, in the worst way imaginable… until the Swifties saved his life.

Glazer wishes the following weren’t true, but he has a powerpoint full of receipts to prove it: he was a strip club sponsored roller hockey goalie, nearly became an opium kingpin, shared his phone number with the world in a stupid prank gone wrong, and somehow became the CIA on Instagram.

Kellen Schneider, known for his role in AppleTV’s Platonic and featuring on the road for SNL‘s Michael Longfellow, is equally as chaotic as Mike but slightly more socialized. Kellen brings a shotgun approach to comedy that partners well with Mike’s laser-focused snipes.

Mike and Kellen both burnt it all down. Come hear how they plan to blow it back up.

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT—UCB’s signature improv juggernaut—is a live improv comedy show in Los Angeles at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre. An all-star comedy show featuring comedians you know from SNL, Dropout, and the world of Film & Television doing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

What Is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians taking the stage with a surprise celebrity guest. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our “monologist “ shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestions. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world.

Previous celebrity guests include: Will Ferrell, Mark Hamill, Tina Fey, Charles Barkley, Don Cheadle, Elizabeth Banks, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani, Amy Poehler, Robin Williams and more.

Why See ASSSSCAT?

ASSSSCAT is one of the best improv comedy shows in Los Angeles. Each show is a one-of-a-kind live comedy experience. Whether you’re a longtime fan of UCB or searching for live comedy in LA for the first time, or looking for new exciting date ideas in LA, ASSSSCAT offers a chance to see the best comedians in LA at the top of their game, and don’t forget the surprise celebrity guest at every show! And don’t worry, if you can’t see the show live, we also offer a LIVESTREAM option for all performances!

shows.description:
An inclusive mic for all comedic formats and all comedic performers!

Hosted by Blumpkin (Zachary Clark, Jacqueline Blizzard, Evie Barenberg, Luke Maynus, Charlie Berger, Journee Nia Brown, Vincent Biello, Macy Mcgrail, Dean Blizzard, Bini Yamin, Melia Hagino)

BYOT (“Bring Your Own Thing”) is UCB’s open mic that welcomes everyone in the comedy community (that means you!) to “bring your own thing,” whatever that may be! Sketch, improv, stand-up, musical comedy, characters, meta-textual deconstructions or just screaming wildly at the audience – whatever you want!

Continuing the legacy of the original BYOT (“Bring Your Own Team”) from the old UCBEast, every 2nd and 4th Sunday night at 9pm, Blumpkin will welcome all to strut their wild stuff for a welcoming and laughing audience. Go nuts – it’s a comedy laboratory! There WILL be open beakers of toxic & poisonous chemicals all over everything.

RULES:
– Signups will be available on this Google Form and on Instagram (@byotmic) on Sundays at 2pm. If you miss the signup, feel free to come through anyway and we will try to get you on!
– Everyone will get 4 minutes, but improv teams get 5 minutes (wow). Feel free to do less time if you want too!
– No targeted hatred/bigotry will be tolerated.

FREE TO ATTEND, NO RESERVATION NEEDED FOR ENTRY!

—-

Lineup is subject to change. Ages 17+

shows.description:
Gravid Water is a theater/improv mash-up featuring the biggest names in comedy, theater, TV, and film.

Gravid Water is a theatrical-comedy experiment where actors are given real scenes from real plays that they prepare as they would for a regular play. They are paired with improvisers who have no prior knowledge of the scenes—seeing and reacting to them for the first time on stage. The always surprising results are hilarious, heartbreaking, and everything in between. Gravid Water has played to sold-out houses in New York and Los Angeles for over fifteen years, as well as the Kennedy Center and theaters across the country. Starring the biggest names in comedy, Broadway, television, and movies, Gravid Water is honored to bring this wild experiment back home to the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre.

shows.title: Out With It
shows.excerpt: OUT WITH IT (Rough House Puppet Arts) In this wild and lyrical piece of puppetry-infused physical theater, a fastidious clown takes on the forces of chaos. In a collision of found-object puppetry, movement, and clown, Out With It unpacks the roug...
shows.description: OUT WITH IT (Rough House Puppet Arts) In this wild and lyrical piece of puppetry-infused physical theater, a fastidious clown takes on the forces of chaos. In a collision of found-object puppetry, movement, and clown, Out With It unpacks the rough and tender realities of holding things in and letting things go. Created & Performed by Claire Saxe Co-Directed by Michael Brown Original Music by Lia Kohl Movement Co-Direction by Chih-Jou Cheng Rough House Puppet Arts is on a mission to connect individuals and communities through puppetry-arts, celebrating the weird things that make us unique, and the weirder things that bring us together. Rough House’s work collides puppetry with physical theater, music, visual arts, and an insatiable taste for experimentation. Claire Saxe (Creator/Performer) is a puppeteer, performer, and theater maker driven by work that stretches forms, genres and expectations. As an independent artist and Artistic Director of Rough House Puppet Arts her practice interweaves elements of puppetry and physical theater. Other credits include We Missed the Train and Had to Wait in Steppenwolf Theater’s LookOut series (Creator & Performer), the U.S. tour of Théâtre de l’Entrouvert’s Anywhere (Director), House of the Exquisite Corpse (Co-Creator & Director), Invitation to a Beheading (Co-Creator & Performer), and others. As an actor Claire has performed on regional stages, in storefronts, on festival platforms, and in DIY spaces across the U.S. and U.K. Check out more of what's up at Rough House! www.roughhousepuppets.org Stay in the loop! @RoughPuppets on Instagram

shows.description:
Chris Gethard (HBO’s Career Suicide, Beautiful/Anonymous, The Office) examines his family’s immigration journey 100 years after their arrival in America.

In 1928, my grandfather left a small village in Northern Ireland and eventually made his way to America. 100 years later I ask: was it worth it? If he knew America (see Minneapolis, MN and Newark, NJ) was going to wind up looking so much like Northern Ireland (see Belfast, Derry, etc), would he have sacrificed everything?

Sub-topics and questions include: Irish-American hypocrisy, “Did I fund the IRA as a small child?”, the under-appreciated cultural impact of 90s hip hop group House of Pain, the strange and strained relationship between Irish people and Irish-Americans, and what it’s like to visit your ancestral village only to find out that it’s segregated to this day and still full of pain.

Please keep in mind that this is very much a work-in-progress and the experience of attending will be less of a traditional show and more of a dialogue between performer and audience. This show is being kept extraordinarily cheap as a recognition that it is an evolving experiment and this evening represents its very beginning stages. Your feedback will be welcomed and the hope is that you will find it intriguing, challenging, and exciting to help a thoughtful hour of comedic storytelling rise up from the ooze on its way to becoming something fully formed.

Featuring: Chris Gethard

—-

Tickets are $5 plus fees.

Under 17 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please use discretion, as all our shows can potentially use adult/sexual material, language, and images.

shows.excerpt: A low-stakes open mic where comedians have the options of filming their sets and getting constructive feedback from the crowd. Come through to the UCB Annex every 4th Tuesday of the month to get some stage time in a supportive…
shows.description:
A low-stakes open mic where comedians have the options of filming their sets and getting constructive feedback from the crowd.

Come through to the UCB Annex every 4th Tuesday of the month to get some stage time in a supportive room, practice your routine, and get some clips to feed the ever-hungry Content Machine!

This is a fun, low-stakes mic for experienced performers as well as Improv students who have been flirting with the idea of stand-up. You will have the option of doing a regular 5 minutes or to reserve some of your time for positive, constructive feedback.

We’ll get as many comics up as we can so we can all create some of that sweet, sweet content for Our Lord And Savior, The Algorithm.

Womxn, trans, non-binary, and LGBTQIA+ strongly encouraged. Let’s make a space that feels safe and comfortable for everyone.

Hosted by Abbey Perez

This event is FREE! Just walk in.

shows.excerpt: An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable. The comedy laboratory where anything can happen! Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its…
shows.description:
An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable.

The comedy laboratory where anything can happen!

Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its own theme, challenge, or format, so no two nights are the same.

One week, comedians might be doing crowd work. The next, they could be battling A.I in a joke battle, getting “analyzed” by therapists, or trying a brand-new experiment.

Whether it works perfectly or completely falls apart, that’s part of the fun.

Show: 9:30 PM
Doors & comic sign-ups: 9:00 PM

Each comic gets up to 5 minutes. 15 performance spots available.

Hosted by Deric Brown

shows.description: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment. Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! People can’t stop RAVEN about this show! Comedians, journalists, and politicians debate all the local issues causing drama in your neighborhood’s Facebook group.

From bike lanes and outdoor dining to dog poop and rats, our panel of comedians and experts gets to the bottom of how this insane and beautiful city works. We’ll also quiz the audience on their own New York knowledge.

Hosted by New York City’s most informed voters, Cody Lindquist (Colbert, Broad City, PTA Executive Board) and Charlie Todd (Improv Everywhere, Pixar In Real Life, Community Board).

Not In My Backyard! has featured performers from The Daily Show and Saturday Night Live, journalists from The New York Times, NY1, and MSNOW, as well as Borough Presidents, NYC Council Members, State Senators, and State Assembly Members.

This Month’s Panelists:

Jason Selvig (The Good Liars)

shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. shows.title: CONNOR RATLIFF presents THE ACTING CLASS
shows.excerpt: A one-person improv show disguised as an acting class, from the creator of the Dead Eyes podcast. Professional actor (Widow's Bay, Bob's Burgers, “King Henry” in a recent State Farm ad) and award-winning podcaster (Dead Eyes) CONNOR RATLIFF is a…
shows.description:
A one-person improv show disguised as an acting class, from the creator of the Dead Eyes podcast.

Professional actor (Widow’s Bay, Bob’s Burgers, “King Henry” in a recent State Farm ad) and award-winning podcaster (Dead Eyes) CONNOR RATLIFF is a classically trained performer who graduated “with honours” from the prestigious Liverpool Institute For Performing Arts over a quarter of a century ago, making his professional debut on the stage of the Royal Court Theatre in London’s West End. During that same year, he also performed at Buckingham Palace for Queen Elizabeth II. In the decades that followed, he has accumulated numerous credits as a star of stage, screen and stream, appearing in multiple Netflix Original Films as well as content on CBS, NBC, FOX, TBS, Nickelodeon, TruTV, Home Box Office, Amazon Prime, Apple TV and the now-defunct comedy platforms, Go90 and Seeso.

But none of that matters now.

What matters now is CONNOR RATLIFF presents THE ACTING CLASS, an unending series of workshop performances where he will, before your very eyes, demonstrate what acting truly IS.

Each performance will be slightly interactive and completely improvised, with occasional opportunities for “students” to participate (from the safety of their position in the audience.)

[Sometimes, there will be a guest, and occasionally they will not be announced in advance. Previous “announced” guests include Jack Quaid, Zach Cherry, Patrick Wilson, James III, Jeff Hiller and Griffin Newman; “surprise” guests have included Meg Ryan and Rachel Zegler.]

Defiantly self-indulgent and beyond pointless, THE ACTING CLASS is your opportunity to witness the kind of greatness – only slightly appreciated by The Industry – that has kept Connor Ratliff steadily employed for nearly half of the past 10+ years.

Praise for Connor Ratliff:

“Connor Ratliff is a brilliant and funny comedic performer and actor.”
THE NEW YORKER

“An Improv Star.”

VANITY FAIR

“An Improv Ace.”

MEN’S JOURNAL

“Funny.”

THE F

shows.description: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. shows.title: Blueprint
shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

shows.description: Step into the one glamorous but now lovingly frayed Blue Velvet Lounge, where the only thing not improvised are the jazz standards crooned by lounge singer Seth Lowry. As Seth’s velvet voice fades, the ensemble sweeps in, spinning spontaneous scenes inspired directly by the songs just performed. One moment, you’re eavesdropping on the eccentric regulars tucked into the lounge’s candlelit corners; the next, you’re whisked far beyond the club to follow the unexpected lives of the characters you just met—bartenders with secret ambitions, mysterious strangers with tangled pasts, and dreamers who stepped into the Blue Velvet for reasons they can’t quite explain. Playful, surprising, and steeped in a retro-cool vibe, this show blends live music and improvised storytelling into a one-of-a-kind night where every note inspires a new twist—and every visit to the Blue Velvet reveals something you’ve never seen before.

When Mike finds one dying in the woods and is given the only known copy of the recipe, he has to decide if he can return it to the monastery that keeps it safe or die trying. DRINK PACKAGE : Select "GA + Drink Package" to have our 4 specialty cocktails brought to your table at key moments during the show. Server gratuity is included in the price. NOTE: These are four full cocktails, not tastings. Please drink responsibly . Not feeling a drink? No problem! The Last Word can be enjoyed entirely on its own. We believe the cocktails enhance the show, not make it. Select "General Admission" for a ticket without cocktails. Content Warning: Flashing lights, loud sounds, profanity, depictions of violence, themes of death, alcohol consumption/abuse, depictions of weapon-use. shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago “…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune “Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader “Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago “Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune “Indisputably great improv, fueled by smart plot development, stage chemistry and recognizable characters.” -Centerstage Chicago “In short, outstanding.” -TimeOut Chicago Find out more at improvisedshakespeare.com _________________________ Additional option to include Improvised Shakespeare's featured cocktail, Hamlet , with your ticket. It includes Nolets Dry Gin, St-Germaine, Campari, orange juice, and garnished with an orange wedge. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on. Grab your token and place it on your table. Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.

shows.description: Napier and Zolno! Famous Comedy Duo! No! They are not! A student of Mick’s in the 90s, Ben Zolno has used none of this inspiration to stun and confuse improv audiences from America to New Zealand. Now Ben's back with Mick for just one challenging night: SHORT-HANDED – a no-safety-net short-form duo show, with simple rules. The games require an MC, but they do not get an MC. The scenes require multiple characters, but Ben and Mick only have themselves to play every single one. And they have to be funny. And touching. And fun. You and your friends will get plenty of gut-wrenching laughs from their reunion, and likely a bit of schadenfreude at their expense, as you catch them SHORT-HANDED!

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

An additional donation option for going above and beyond is also featured in the ticket options! Here’s some info about Gilda’s Club! Gilda’s Club Chicago uplifts and strengthens people impacted by cancer by providing support, fostering compassionate communities, and breaking down barriers to care. At Gilda's Club Chicago, we have seen firsthand the power of connecting individuals and families who are navigating the challenges of a cancer diagnosis. Through our free programs and services, we provide a safe and welcoming space where people can come together, share their stories, and find support from others who truly understand. We know cancer doesn’t discriminate, so Gilda’s Club is for EVERYONE impacted by cancer across gender identity, age, ethnicity, cancer type, immigration status, and religious belief. 8/28 Sheryl: Sydney Back Zalia Maya Kayla McCaffrey Stevie McDunn Cadence Messier Veronica Rooney Takahana Savolainen Katie Terres Matty Vergun Sera Young

shows.title: The Armando Diaz Experience
shows.description: The legendary show is reborn! Created in 1995 at the iO Theater in Chicago, The Armando Diaz Experience IS the longest running improv show EVER. A guest monologist takes a suggestion from the audience and shares true stories from their life. These stories are then brought to life by a rotating cast of improv all-stars, which take audiences on a high minded, exhilarating comedic joy ride that will leave mouths tired of smiling. And occasionally, just occasionally, the man with his name on the show will drop by for some fun. "The “Armando,” performed every Saturday, always begins with a monologue, and at a recent show it was about a connection made on the internet that led a decade later to a real-life relationship. The team of improvisers built patient scenes off this moving story, which made daring shifts in perspective, from the real world to secret worlds, inside and outside of bodies. There was a playfulness to the creativity, bold choices that verged on reckless that wouldn’t make the transition to a script." shows.excerpt: A brutally honest comedy about keeping tiny humans alive when you are dying inside. Created and performed by playwright, comedian, and viral creator Brandon Ogborn, SAHD (Stay-At-Home Dad) is a brutally honest one-man show about what happens when someone who…
shows.description:
A brutally honest comedy about keeping tiny humans alive when you are dying inside.

Created and performed by playwright, comedian, and viral creator Brandon Ogborn, SAHD (Stay-At-Home Dad) is a brutally honest one-man show about what happens when someone who grew up homeschooled in a religious cult tries to become a normal stay-at-home dad. From navigating the daily chaos of raising small children to processing his father’s thirteen-year obsession with creating a Rush Limbaugh board game, carbon monoxide poisoning, and cosmic fire truck visits, Ogborn weaves together stories that are equal parts ridiculous and truly heartbreaking. Through deeply personal storytelling, he discovers that the people who drive us crazy are often the same ones who somehow keep us sane.

Created and performed by Brandon Ogborn

Directed by Karole Foreman

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

shows.title: Metal Boy Presents: Your Worst Idea
shows.description: Behind every great idea, there are 50 other terrible ones that came first. Your Worst Idea takes the garbage, shines it up, and gives it a second chance. Each show, we'll invite a guest to offer up a never-before-seen work of art (a poem from 7th grade! A terrible sketch! Pages from a diary!). Metal Boy will perform a live reading, then like a phoenix, spin comedy gold from its ashes. The cast of Your Worst Idea includes comedy vets from all over NYC—credits include: Search Party (HBO), Birdgirl and The Venture Bros. (Adult Swim), the Rude Tales of Magic podcast, Baby Wants Candy, Reductress, The Truth podcast, Story Pirates, Improv Everywhere, and UCB Comedy. They also once performed an improv show before a free screening of a Zack Galifiankis movie. Heather Seltzer will be playing Portia in the upcoming NYC Fringe show "Portia and Ellen," a tragic comedy that she wrote about marriage and cancel culture. A screenwriter represented by Zero Gravity Management, she was shortlisted for the 2025 5th Cannes Screenplay List and was a 2023 Big Break Screenwriting Contest Finalist. She is an alum of Broadway to Go, Magnet Theater's Lady Sketch Show and the all-female indie improv team Mama Like. Heather is the creator, director and a writer of “Dance Party Time,” an award-winning comedic web series for kids that stars neurodivergent young adults. Magnet Theater 254 West 29th St. New York NY 10001 Tickets Metal Boy Presents: Your Worst Idea Sat Aug 29th, 2026 9:00pm - $17 Buy Ticket

shows.description:
See a brand new sketch or solo show birthed right before your eyes that is auditioning for a run at the UCB theater.

It’s a show where we let sketch teams and solo performers try some shit out!

Some will be good, some will be bad but it will all be weird and new and that’s what makes it fun!

It’s experimental sketch at its finest! Come on, you know you need a spanking.

This Sunday, we have…

Little French Boy Sketch Troupe Presents: What We Know About American Culture and Comedy

Let these Little French Boys dazzle you with their Big American Sketches!

LFB is an indie sketch team that has sold out shows across Los Angeles. Their online videos have garnered over 20 million views and a surprisingly low amount of rude comments, for the internet.

Catch a new hour of live sketch comedy every month at The Pack or a new minute of prerecorded video every week @funnylittlefrenchboy

Little French Boy is comprised of Carey Adkins, Caleb Dollar, Matt Duckett, Laura Manasewich, Josh Noble, Lizzy Rudakas, Hannah Watzke.

Directed by Maestro John Milhiser (SNL, UCB)

**Note: the members of LFB are not in fact French or Little Boys

Au Revoir for now! Or as the French say, baguette!

shows.description:
An improv show based on Kelsi Roberts’ real childhood crush diary entries! It’s all my hilariously cringe-worthy confessions about my crushes brought to life on stage.

My Secret Crush Book is a long-form improvised show inspired by Kelsi Roberts‘ real early 2000s childhood crush diary. A scrapbook filled with cutout photos of every boy I was crushing on, along with the overly dramatic notes I wrote about them. Each page sparks a brand-new, improvised world, diving into awkward fantasies and cringe-worthy confessions! The show has played sold-out crowds at The Groundlings, Lyric Hyperion, and the Elysian.

Featuring: Kelsi Roberts, Jasmine Elist, Jackie Young, Lauren Holt, Daniel Robbins, Geoff Ross, Chad Westbrook, Artoun Nazareth

shows.description:
UCBNY presents a *FREE* ASSSSCAT!

Tickets for this show are free, but you must make a reservation online and arrive prior to 8:25pm for a seat. Seating is first come first served so any arrival after 8:25pm is not guaranteed.

Tickets will become available on Friday, August 28th, at 12pm ET. Come back to this page then!

If you do not reserve a seat in advance, please still show up anyways and we’ll try to get you in if there are some no-shows!

ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

—

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT—UCB’s signature improv juggernaut—is a live improv comedy show in Los Angeles at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre. An all-star comedy show featuring comedians you know from SNL, Dropout, and the world of Film & Television doing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

What Is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians taking the stage with a surprise celebrity guest. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our “monologist “ shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestions. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world.

Previous celebrity guests include: Will Ferrell, Mark Hamill, Tina Fey, Charles Barkley, Don Cheadle, Elizabeth Banks, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani, Amy Poehler, Robin Williams and more.

Why See ASSSSCAT?

ASSSSCAT is one of the best improv comedy shows in Los Angeles. Each show is a one-of-a-kind live comedy experience. Whether you’re a longtime fan of UCB or searching for live comedy in LA for the first time, or looking for new exciting date ideas in LA, ASSSSCAT offers a chance to see the best comedians in LA at the top of their game, and don’t forget the surprise celebrity guest at every show! And don’t worry, if you can’t see the show live, we also offer a LIVESTREAM option for all performances!

shows.excerpt: A good-natured stand-up open mic where Beth Stelling punches your jokes up (when possible) Hi! I'm comedian Beth Stelling. I headlined Omaha Comedy Festival a few years ago and they asked me to lead a stand-up workshop, which I don't…
shows.description:
A good-natured stand-up open mic where Beth Stelling punches your jokes up (when possible)

Hi! I’m comedian Beth Stelling. I headlined Omaha Comedy Festival a few years ago and they asked me to lead a stand-up workshop, which I don’t really [know how to] do. When considering what I could offer fellow comedians (novice or otherwise), I figured it was to listen and offer feedback in the form of a tag or punchline. So we did that on a Sunday morning with a really great group of varying levels of comedians and it was so fun!

Right now, I think things are feeling dark and roasting one another isn’t helping… therefore I offer you The Punch-up Mic!

It’s a stand-up open mic where you can bring:

• a bit that works and you love but want to make better
• a late night set you’re perfecting
• an idea you want to workout
• you want to try stand-up for the first time!

All ages that are over 18 and experience levels welcome! Let’s get loose.

I, Beth Stelling, have credits if you feel like you need that. I started stand-up in Chicago eighteen years ago and have been in mostly L.A. (Improv and Comedy Store Paid Regular) but a little bit of NYC (passed at The Cellar) as well. I’ve got specials on HBO Max, Netflix, Showtime and Comedy Central but I feel like a good amount of my stuff is ending up on YouTube. I’ve performed late night sets on Conan, Jimmy Kimmel Live, The Pete Holmes Show and Last Call with Carson Daly (I’m 40). I’ve done punch-up on countless comedy movies like Good Boys and some where I signed my right to a credit away for cold hard cash. I’ve written on television shows like Crashing, I Love You America with Sarah Silverman, The Last O.G., Rick and Morty, Another Period and Strange Planet.

—

This show is FREE! Just show up on the day at the UCB Annex if you’d like to perform or join the audience.

shows.description: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s the day for your first open mic (kudos) – The Ya'll Mic is a great venue to workshop your bits. The show is every Tuesday from 5:30pm – 7:30pm. Signup is online and the signup sheet is posted on Facebook & IG on Mondays. The list is emailed out a few hours before the show. Comics get 4 minutes of stage time (and a lifetime of memories.) While all are welcome, the room prioritizes BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and Femme comics. Come laugh with us!

Tomorrow’s headliners, tonight!

Mic Drop is a stand-up comedy open mic and showcase at the UCB Annex featuring rising comics, new material, and surprise sets from some of LA’s funniest performers.

Built around a supportive, comedy-first atmosphere, Mic Drop is a space where comics can take big swings, sharpen their material, and perform in front of a real audience, not just a room full of other comics. Each show features a mix of up-and-coming stand-ups and the unpredictable energy that makes live comedy exciting.

Whether you’re working on your next five minutes or just looking to discover new talent, Mic Drop is where LA comics level up.

shows.description:
An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable.

The comedy laboratory where anything can happen!

Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its own theme, challenge, or format, so no two nights are the same.

One week, comedians might be doing crowd work. The next, they could be battling A.I in a joke battle, getting “analyzed” by therapists, or trying a brand-new experiment.

Whether it works perfectly or completely falls apart, that’s part of the fun.

Show: 9:30 PM
Doors & comic sign-ups: 9:00 PM

Each comic gets up to 5 minutes. 15 performance spots available.

Hosted by Deric Brown

shows.description: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment. Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! People can’t stop RAVEN about this show! shows.excerpt: True stories about the CIA, Taylor Swift, Kanye West, roller hockey, opium, and the creator of Is It Cake? A washed-up roller hockey goalie gets high and sees a double feature of The Exorcist and Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour…
shows.description:
True stories about the CIA, Taylor Swift, Kanye West, roller hockey, opium, and the creator of Is It Cake?

A washed-up roller hockey goalie gets high and sees a double feature of The Exorcist and Taylor Swift’s The Eras Tour movie. That night leads to an adventure involving Travis Kelce, Kanye West, death threats, becoming the CIA on Instagram, and marrying the creator of Netflix’s hit show Is It Cake? This story seems too outlandish to be true, but he has a PowerPoint full of receipts to prove it.

Mike Glazer is chaotic good. His anarchic, true tales have appeared on Comics Unleashed (CBS), Netflix Is A Joke Festival Presents: Mike Glazer, The F Word with Gordon Ramsay (FOX), High Guys (BuzzFeed), and Worst Cooks in America (Food Network). He also crushed a sold-out arena at the NHL Awards and major festivals, including SXSW and Outside Lands, and is an Emmy-nominated writer for HBO.

shows.description:
The Definitive Celebration of America’s Greatest Minds

Great Americans is the flagship biographical retrospective series of the American Institute of Importance, the nation’s leading nonprofit dedicated to celebrating the figures who shaped this country.

Join Henry Block (The Onion) and some of UCB’s top performers as the Institute inducts a new class of honorees: Scientists. Inventors. Various women in shawls shouting obscenities in public. Through a series of live dramatic presentations, audiences are granted unprecedented access to the lives, legacies, and defining contributions of these essential Americans.

Let us be clear: These are the most important people in our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard of them, you’re being hysterical and no one believes you.

shows.description:
The StoryQuest crew tells a chaotic D&D tale where special guests control their fate, as the Dungeon Master changes at the ring of a bell.

Join the StoryQuest crew, Mayanna Berrin (Dispatch, Dungeon Masters), Reed Sights (Webtoon), David Tilstra (From Afar Podcast), Jordy Martin (Pack Theater) and friends for a chaotic Dungeons and Dragons show.

In 75 minutes the StoryQuest crew will take audience suggestions to create a Dungeons and Dragons adventure on the fly, all the while frantically changing which character they’re playing, what podium they’re standing at, and who’s running the show as the Dungeon Master (and everything else) changes each time their hilarious guests rings a bell.

Past Guests have included Johnny Stanton (Dropout), Surena Marie (Dimension 20), and Luis Carazo (Critical Role).

shows.excerpt: If you’re looking for a date night, girls’ night out, or a mandatory work outing (that your staff will actually like) — Look no further! Fast, funny, and frothy, Thursday Night Improv is entirely improvised and features a different guest opener f...
shows.description: If you’re looking for a date night, girls’ night out, or a mandatory work outing (that your staff will actually like) — Look no further! Fast, funny, and frothy, Thursday Night Improv is entirely improvised and features a different guest opener for veteran iO house team Creamboy every week. Every show is completely different, so you can keep coming back for more! Will you be the lucky audience member to receive the coveted title of Cream of the Week? Creamboy is made up of seasoned Chicago improvisers who play and teach all over the city (and country! And WORLD?!) which means this show is perfect for improv nerds, millennials who love Tina Fey, and even your cousin visiting from Kansas. Comedy so good you'll lick your lips and pat your belly. Mmmm so creamy! Get a taste of Creamboy on Instagram @ creamboy.io

shows.title: Improv: The Play
shows.excerpt: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never ...
shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. Featuring: Alex Beard Heather Mari Elijah Sloan Lexi Putter Lucas Pollitzer Marino Korellis Montrez Hawkins Nikk Tetreault Ryan Bowman Shawna Seals Directed by: James Dugan Produced by: Cory Hardin

Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

Showbiz credits include: screenwriter of The Heat, co-author of the Broadway musical Beetlejuice, star/co-creator of Playing House, staff writer for Big Mouth, series regular of Superstore, founders of at least two improv schools, voice-over artist in a million cartoons, producer of the hit show Makin’ It, but most relevant: having done improv on stage for 20 years.

THE BIG TEAM (formerly known as White Women) is an improv team of all black men based in Los Angeles. Formed after meeting at the UCB Black History Month Show in 2013, this team has been featured at theaters all over Los Angeles and the country, having headlined festivals in Portland, DC, Austin, NYC, and more.

Collectively they have written and produced videos for Comedy Central, College Humor and Funny or Die, and individually they’ve written and acted in a lot of your favorite TV shows. They were named on Vulture’s annual list of “Comedians You Should and Will Know” in 2018.

shows.description:
Improvisers swap mystery backpacks and justify bizarre props on a chaotic audience chosen trip!

Pack your bags for a no holds barred improvised trip – be it a family reunion, camping trip, or work retreat.

Before the show, each comedian secretly packs a backpack full of strange and random props. The improvisers exchange backpacks onstage at the beginning of the show and then must use and justify why ‘they’ brought each of the various props on the “trip.”

All edible props must be consumed by the unfortunate soul who pulls it out.

Hosted by Joseph Elston & Blake Edwards

shows.description:
An all-ages improv show for kids AND adults featuring UCB’s best improvisers plus a chance for kids to get onstage themselves!

Come join some of UCB’s best improvisers as they put on an all-ages comedy show so deeply appropriate, you can bring your kids to it! In fact, you SHOULD bring your kids to it! But wait… there’s more!

Not only will you get to see a great improv set from some of Los Angeles’s best performers, kids in the audience 5 and up will also get the opportunity to hop on the UCB stage and do some improv themselves (while the adults just try to hold on) in a fun, funny and supportive environment. What’s more wildly appropriate than that?

Hosted by Mae Tarica Fernie (age 7) as well as Deborah Tarica and Alex Fernie (who are much older).

With special guests: Nnamdi Ngwe, Isabella Escalante, Greg Tuculescu

shows.description: Chicago's longest running short-form improv show (founded in 1987) and the only comedy show in Chicago EVERYONE is welcome at - from age 8 to 80, our inclusive 'everyone is welcome' approach to comedy makes us perfect for patrons of all ages. Whether you're bringing your family, your co-workers, or a date - you are welcome, and you will laugh. ComedySportz is two teams of all-star improv comedians going head to head in comedy games, scenes and songs. YOU will vote on which team you liked the best and the teams will score points based on your applause. One of our world-famous referees will guide you through the whole show and may even ask for your help on stage. Every show ends in our incredible 6 THINGS game that is known throughout the world as 'the hardest game in all of improv'. It's fast. It's hilarious. It's appropriate for all ages. It's ComedySportz.

shows.description: "...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader Improvised Jane Austen continues its entirely improvised tales of love and laughter this summer. Audiences will enjoy an evening with wit and heart in equal measure with an improvised rom-com for everyone, whether you love Austen or just like to laugh! Improvised Jane Austen currently performs Saturday nights at 6:00 pm at iO Theater and tickets are $20. "...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago Join Improvised Jane Austen for the signature romantic comedy and social satire of the beloved author, improvised by Chicago's top comedic talent. Celebrate all things love, friendship, and Austen this Summer. “...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to create a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. The current cast of 20+ performers rotate weekly, creating a new ensemble for every show. Come for the humor, stay for the heart! Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended , named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick , voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago , and was featured on WTTW playlist , in Time Out , the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day , on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago . Learn more: https://improvisedjaneausten.com/

shows.description:
3 teams, 2 UCB legend monologists, 1 student mashup, 0 regrets.

An improv show celebrating the Armando form and UCB’s legendary ASSSSCAT! Hosted by The Craft, this show brings together students, indie performers, and UCB legends!

Each show features four teams: The Craft, two invited improv teams, and a student mash-up team made up of performers who sign up at the show (names pulled from a bucket!). Two rotating UCB performers (teachers, alumni, house team members) join each month as the monologist and guest players!

Whether you’re a student looking to jump into the mash-up or a comedy fan who loves to laugh, come join us for a show that celebrates the awesome talent in the UCB community!

Hosted by The Craft: Bonnie Efird, Sarah Dooley, Lucy Hamilburg, Katie Roletto, Holly Celeste, Alex Paisley Stedman, Kate Bera, Leanne Velednitsky
